When astronomers discover a rogue black hole speeding through the Milky Way, they investigate how much danger this cosmic monster poses to Earth, and what would happen if it ever entered our solar system.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E02 — NASA's Journey to Mars
NASA plans to send humans to Mars within just 15 years, but to reach this next frontier of space exploration, experts must discover new technology and cutting-edge science that protects astronauts from the Red Planet's deadliest killers.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E08 — Monsters of the Milky Way
The center of the Milky Way is home to strange and deadly phenomena that is difficult to understand; with the help of science, experts reveal how the black hole, the galaxy's core, shapes life on Earth.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S02 E01 — Birth of the Bermuda Triangle
Using the latest cutting-edge tech, a team of experts investigates new leads behind the SS Cotopaxi, a mysterious shipwreck that may have launched the infamous legend of the Bermuda Triangle.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E04 — Titanic's Lost Sister
When a sister ship of the Titanic gets embroiled in war with a hidden enemy, the former luxury liner is sent to the bottom of the ocean; new discoveries and cutting-edge underwater technology might finally reveal the secret history of its sinking.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
Nazis in the Bermuda Triangle
New evidence in the Bermuda Triangle could reveal that Nazis got closer to America than ever believed; using the latest cutting-edge underwater technology, experts investigate the truth behind the shipwreck that shouldn't exist.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E02 — Ghost Fleet of Doom
New discoveries reveal the treasures of a ghost fleet of Japanese ships at the bottom of the South Pacific, and using cutting-edge underwater technology, experts investigate a top-secret superweapon that could have changed the course of World War II.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E05 — Secrets of the Scorpion
A nuclear submarine goes missing while spying on Soviet maneuvers, and its wreckage is found on the ocean floor.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E03 — Nazi Doomsday Project
Brand-new evidence reveals the secrets of a Nazi program to build a nuclear bomb; using cutting-edge science and technology, experts uncover classified files that reveal how close Hitler came to this terrifying super weapon.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E04 — Yellowstone Supervolcano
Beneath Yellowstone National Park is one of the world's largest active volcanoes, and it's poised to erupt at any moment; experts use seismic technology and visual imaging to reveal its catastrophic threat.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E08 — Antarctic Trail of Doom
Using cutting-edge forensic analyses, some of the world's leading investigative experts uncover the stunning truth behind compelling mysteries from ancient times to the recent past.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E02 — Mystery at Alcatraz
Three inmates are said to have escaped from Alcatraz prison, but even today, it's never been proven; new evidence might finally crack this notorious cold case, as experts use forensic science and cutting-edge technology to investigate fresh leads.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E10 — Secrets of the Sonic Weapon
American diplomats stationed in Cuba begin to experience a bizarre mixture of noxious neurological symptoms and seem to be under a mysterious attack; experts use cutting-edge forensic science to determine if a sinister, sonic weapon is at play.

description:
S04 E05 — Curse of the Full Moon
Cosmonauts are trapped in a capsule in a frozen lake; a NASA scientist investigates the Hindenburg; the full moon affects experiments.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E02 — Aliens vs. Stalin at Area 51
When a former Area 51 insider alleges that the Roswell UFO incident was a nefarious Soviet conspiracy masterminded by Stalin, experts investigate if it was indeed an enemy plot against America -- or if the confession is just another cover-up.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
How to Build a Planet
Some of the brightest minds and theorists on the planet explore the limits of human knowledge and explain the science behind the rules of the universe.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E07 — Edge of the Universe
We don't yet know where the edge of the universe is or what happens there; but thanks to cutting-edge technology and new discoveries, experts might finally reveal the secrets of the phenomena.

title: Savage Builds
description:
S01 E01 — Building Iron Man
Richard Browning, the inventor and chief test pilot of the Gravity Jet Suit, which is powered by five 1,000-horsepower mini jet engines, helps get Adam's titanium Marvel Studios' Iron Man-inspired suit to fly.

title: Savage Builds
description:
S01 E02 — Wheel of Death
Adam Savage and a NASA engineer team up to build a rocket-propelled experimental super-weapon that could have changed the course of World War II; using cutting-edge tech, they try to make this notorious engineering failure an explosive success.

title: Savage Builds
description:
S01 E03 — Mad Max Melee
Adam Savage and inventors build a deadly fleet of junkyard vehicles that look straight out of "Mad Max," and using scrapyard materials and wicked-smart engineering, they face off to see whose motorized monster packs the most vicious punch.

title: Savage Builds
description:
S01 E04 — Forging Excalibur
Adam wants to build his own version of King Arthur's legendary sword: Excalibur; using the iron found in a meteorite, he attempts to make an indestructible weapon.

title: Savage Builds
description:
S01 E05 — Nitro Explode-aganza
Adam Savage and a demolition expert team up to test one of the most dangerous and explosive substances on the planet, and cutting-edge science and tech will reveal if nitroglycerine really deserves its notorious reputation.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E10 — Gravitational Waves Revealed
Gravitational waves are helping scientists explore the cosmos in revolutionary, new ways, and the discoveries they make are revealing the universe's greatest mysteries.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E07 — The Next Supernova
The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E09 — Birth of the Monster Black Holes
New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E11 — Mystery of Alien Worlds
An explosion in the discovery of exoplanets is challenging everything we know about our universe; experts use cutting-edge astronomy to investigate these mysterious alien worlds and how they defy the laws of physics.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E06 — War of the Galaxies
Galaxies are locked in continual combat across the universe, and the Milky Way will face its biggest opponent ever, the Andromeda Galaxy, in a titanic and deadly struggle that could create a new and unrecognizable super galaxy.

title: Strip the Cosmos
description: Stripping celestial bodies layer by layer to get at the heart of what makes the universe tick.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E01 — Asteroid Apocalypse: The New Threat
If a massive asteroid collides with Earth, it could end life on the planet as one knows it; new discoveries reveal just how close civilization is to apocalypse and what it would take for the world's leading space agencies to stop it.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E07 — Mystery of the Invisible Planet
A probe malfunctions without cause as it enters deep space; a mission goes astray when an imposter breaches Mission Control; evidence of an invisible planet within the Solar System.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E01 — Saturn's Moon Monsters
When NASA discovers something strange on Saturn's biggest moon, experts investigate if aliens feeding on the world's electric atmosphere could be the culprit; the disturbing evidence points to an apocalypse if these monsters ever make it to Earth.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E03 — Hunt for Alien Evidence
The discovery of extraterrestrial life might face an impossible challenge: the physics of the universe itself; using cutting-edge tech, experts might be on the verge of a groundbreaking find, and the evidence could already be in hand.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E05 — Secrets of Time Travel
Time travel may be more possible now than ever imagined, and today, cutting-edge technology and the latest research into black holes and wormholes is helping experts get much closer to discovering how to travel through time.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E06 — Buried Lab of the Black Hills
Buried nearly a mile beneath the Black Hills of South Dakota is a cutting-edge laboratory at the forefront of astonishing scientific research; experts reveal advancements engineers achieved more than a century ago that keep it operating today.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E07 — Subterranean Silo Survival
A decommissioned missile launch facility in Kansas remained one of the best kept subterranean military secrets of the Cold War; experts reveal how this abandoned underground complex transformed into a state-of-the-art survival bunker.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E08 — Italy's Subterranean Secret
An unprecedented landslide unveils a hidden world beneath a picturesque town in northern Italy, and now experts investigate this vast network of tunnels and passageways that stretch 300 feet underground to reveal the city's subterranean past.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E09 — Ireland's Underground Alcatraz
Subterranean military fortresses situated on the southern coast of Ireland have protected against enemy invasion for over 400 years, and now, experts investigate how this powerful stronghold transformed into a brutal and terrifying prison.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E10 — Medieval Maze of Secrets
A forgotten world of ancient underground passages and medieval engineering lies hidden beneath the town of Exeter, England; experts investigate and reveal how this ambitious tunnel system was the result of one of the deadliest epidemics in history.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E01 — Derelict Housing of Protest
The bizarre remnants of a housing complex lie mysteriously deserted in an Ohio industrial town; experts investigate and uncover the dark, turbulent past of an oppressive steel company and labor strikes that resulted in deadly riots.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E06 — Romanian Royal Desolation
A once lavish destination in the mountains of Romania is now in disrepair and mysteriously deserted; experts investigate these sprawling ruins and uncover the remains of a luxurious resort caught in a web of corruption.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E03 — Desolation of Ponte City
A looming skyscraper that was once an exclusive residential complex turns into a dystopian ruin in Johannesburg, South Africa; experts investigate and uncover a symbolic structure of urban decay under the shameful shadow of apartheid.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S12 E07 — Countdown to Armageddon
A remote site in Arkansas plays a major role in a high-stakes Cold War drama, an ancient ruin in Cambodia is ravaged by one man's cruel deception and a French fort becomes the symbol of a heroic but doomed resistance.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S12 E04 — Ghost Town in Palermo
A ghost town in Sicily has deep roots in organized crime; an obscure asylum in Pennsylvania shocks America and inspires a revolution; a mansion in Ireland becomes embroiled in a bizarre kidnapping plot.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S12 E03 — Nazi Hospital Horrors
A German house of healing becomes a place of evil, a tin mine out in the jungle becomes the object of colonial interests, and a remote complex in Texas has a long history stemming from America's relationship with Mexico.

S05 E01 — JFK UFO Conspiracy
A declassified letter written by President Kennedy demands that the CIA share its UFO data with NASA; a bizarre pattern on the surface of Mars could be a coded alien message; investigators find a rocket crash-landed in a crater on the Moon.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E07 — Planet of the Metal Aliens
Experts investigate if a nearby exoplanet could be the home to an alien civilization of strange, metallic monsters, after a new discovery confirms that life can thrive on such a strange world.

title: Artemis II: To the Moon and Back
description: NASA sends Americans back to the Moon for the first time in over 50 years and in a new spacecraft; from mission prep to splashdown on Earth, join the Artemis II crew on this 10-day voyage of exploration.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery of the Giants
Many ancient cultures allude to the existence of giants; tombs and skeletons of the alleged beings are discovered in Sardinia.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E03 — The Bloodline of Christ
Investigating the contentious theory that Jesus was married with children and his bloodline lives on today.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E02 — The Third Secret of Fatima
Three Portuguese shepherd children allegedly receive a prophecy in 1917 that foretells the date of the Apocalypse.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E01 — The Lost Treasure of the Templars
Legend has it that the Knights Templar discovered a great treasure in Jerusalem and may have brought it back to England.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E05 — The Treasure of Solomon
Investigating if the High Priests of the Temple in Jerusalem hid sacred items from the Romans, and if the Dead Sea Scrolls can reveal the location of hidden wonders.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E06 — The Secrets of the Alchemists
Investigating whether alchemists such as Nostradamus, Nicolas Flamel and John Dee could truly perform miracles, or were in actuality just clever deceivers.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S05 E09 — Phantoms in the Chamber of Secrets
Evidence of a mysterious 5,000-year-old structure suddenly appears in Ireland; a top-secret machine that can see back in time; a satanic pentagram in the snow that points to witchcraft in the New World.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E03 — Mafia Ghost Ship
A ghost ship with links to the mob suddenly appears on a California beach; strange markings could be a coded message that reveals a plot to overthrow the Queen of England; a lake believed to have magical healing powers holds clues to life on Mars.
